steps.caption: Option 5B · Labelled strip. Same panels, now with names.
Feed, Captures, Suggestions above a line; Ask below; capture at the bottom. Tooltips keep only the key.
Each panel says what it is for in one line, and the pin is a labelled “Keep here”.
A page with suggestions still switches the panel to Suggestions, unless you keep it here.
Empty states now say when a place fills, with one button that leads somewhere.
